            for kind, name, data, parser in [('java-source', 'C.java', b'package a; public class C { @android.annotation.RequiresPermission("android.permission.CAMERA") public void f(int x){} }', lambda b: java_source.parse(b)['records']), ('sdk-api-index', 'api.xml', b'<api version="4"><class name="a/C"><method name="f(I)V"/><field name="VALUE"/></class></api>', lambda b: sdk_api_index.parse(b,target='37.2')['records'])]:
                (r / name).write_bytes(data)
                cache = r / (name + '.gz')
                records = parser(data)
                with gzip.open(cache, 'wt') as f:
                    for row in records:
                        f.write(json.dumps(row) + '\n')
                source = dict(spec['sources'][0], kind=kind, path=name, local_path=name, sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), git_blob=hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\x00' + data).hexdigest(), size_bytes=len(data), url='https://dl.google.com/mock/' + name, platform_api_version='37.2',metadata_cache=dict(path=cache.name, sha256=hashlib.sha256(cache.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), records=len(records),parser_sha256=cache_fingerprint.current(kind)))
                spec['sources'].append(source)

            v = b.build(inv, r / 'out')
            self.assertEqual(v['counts']['sources'], 5)
            docs = [json.loads(l) for l in (r / 'out/entries.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
